web.description:
# Security and Privacy [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/guide/security-privacy#security-and-privacy) ## Checklist [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/guide/security-privacy#checklist) ### Storage buckets [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/guide/security-privacy#storage-buckets) Hosting PMTiles from a public storage bucket and decoding via [pmtiles.js](https://docs.protomaps.com/pmtiles/maplibre) is the simplest publishing method, but allows anyone to download your entire tileset. ### Map Resources [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/guide/security-privacy#map-resources) - For MapLibre GL: Map style JSON, spritesheets, fontstacks, and RTL (right-to-left) text plugins. See [Example Application](https://docs.protomaps.com/guide/security-privacy#example-application) below. ```
``` - `maplibre-gl.js`, `maplibre-gl.css` - JavaScript and CSS for the MapLibre GL rendering library. - `pmtiles.js` - JavaScript for decoding PMTiles archives in the browser. - `basemaps.js` - JavaScript for creating a MapLibre GL style for a basemap tileset.
